description: Complete Data Bundle for PyPSA-Eur: An Open Optimisation Model of the European Transmission System is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Jonas Hörsch, Fabian Hofmann (KIT, FIAS). PyPSA-Eur is an open model dataset of the European power system at the transmission network level that covers the full ENTSO-E area. It can be built using the code provided at https://github.com/PyPSA/PyPSA-eur. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
